title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees
description:
Sharks have been around for more than 400 million years. The oldest known trees are about 385 million years old, so for tens of millions of years there were sharks and no trees at all.

Sources: Stein et al., Nature 2007 (Gilboa fossil trees); Science News; Britannica; Discover Wildlife, 'Are sharks older than trees?'. The age of the very oldest shark scales (~450 million years) is debated, so we say 'over 400 million'.
